name: Захист від прохідних пішаків
description:
You already know that a passed pawn can be very dangerous. You obviously want to defend against this threat.

Basic defense plans against passed pawns are:

  • block a passed pawn by occupying its promotion square
  • stop a passed pawn by controlling its promoting square
  • counterattacks
  • stalemate tricks

It may be necessary to sacrifice material in order to prevent a pawn’s promotion. If you’re up in material, this is not necessarily fatal.

What do you have to do?
Defend against the threat of passed pawns.

examples.text: By first making a clever check, Black can block the white passed pawn with the queen.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Gb7,Yg7][%cal Yg7g8]} 1... d4+ 2. Kxd4 Bd5 3. g8=Q Bxg8 1-0
examples.text: In this example, White frees up space for the bishop by first sacrificing the pawn. The bishop can then cover the promotion square.
The white rooks work nicely together on the bottom tank and restrain the strong pawn.

examples.pgn: {[%csl Yb2,Yh2][%cal Yb2b1]} 1. Qe3+ $1 (1. Qxf6+?   Qg6 2. Qh8+ Qh7 3. Qf6+ Kh5 4. Qxb2 Kg5+ 5. Kg1 Qh1+ 6. Kf2 Qg2+ 7. Ke3 Qxb2) 1... Qxe3 {[%csl Gh2]} 1-0
examples.text: This time it is impossible to stop the pawn. Still, White can keep a draw with a beautiful stalemate-trick!
When a pawn is promoted, the pawn often transforms into a queen. Sometimes it is smart to sacrifice a rook for the pawn. This is the case here!
